description_en: Creates or updates a data masking rule
description_zh: 调用DsgDesensPlanAddOrUpdate接口新建或编辑数据脱敏规则
name: DsgDesensPlanAddOrUpdate

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to add a watermark. Valid values:
true: yes
false: no
fields.help_zh:
是否添加水印。取值如下：
true：是
false：否
fields.name: check_watermark

fields.help_en:
The sensitive field type. Call the DsgQueryDefaultTemplates (https://api.aliyun.com/document/dataworks-public/2020-05-18/DsgQueryDefaultTemplates) operation to query the available types for the current tenant. Obtain the value from Data[].DataType and select a supported masking method from DesensPlanTemplate in the same record.

If the required type is not returned, verify that the template and sensitive fields are configured in the DataWorks console by choosing Data Security Guard > Data Classification. To add a sensitive field, call the QueryDefaultTemplate (https://api.aliyun.com/document/dataworks-public/2020-05-18/QueryDefaultTemplate) operation to view the default template, and then call the AddRecognizeRule (https://api.aliyun.com/document/dataworks-public/2020-05-18/AddRecognizeRule) operation. After the configuration is complete, query the available masking types again
fields.help_zh:
敏感字段类型。调用 DsgQueryDefaultTemplates (https://api.aliyun.com/document/dataworks-public/2020-05-18/DsgQueryDefaultTemplates) 查询当前租户可用的类型，从 `Data[].DataType` 中取值，并在同一条记录的 `DesensPlanTemplate` 中选择支持的脱敏方式。

如果所需类型没有返回，先在 DataWorks 控制台的「数据保护伞 > 分类分级」确认模板和敏感字段已配置。如需新增敏感字段，先调用 QueryDefaultTemplate (https://api.aliyun.com/document/dataworks-public/2020-05-18/QueryDefaultTemplate) 查看默认模板，再调用 AddRecognizeRule (https://api.aliyun.com/document/dataworks-public/2020-05-18/AddRecognizeRule)，配置后重新查询可用的脱敏类型
fields.name: data_type

fields.help_en:
The masking method configured in the data masking rule. Valid values:
hash: hashing
mapping: pseudonymization
mask: masking
charreplacement: character replacement
intervalselect: interval transformation
decimalpoint: rounding
emptydesens: nullification
fields.help_zh:
脱敏规则中配置的脱敏方式。取值如下：
哈希：hash
假名：mapping
掩盖：mask
字符替换：charreplacement
区间变换：intervalselect
取整：decimalpoint
置空：emptydesens
